Use only the two pictures attached to this message (ignore any earlier pictures). They are tile sheets already in this painted isometric golf game: match their style, scale, framing, camera angle, detail level and colours exactly.

Create an image, 4:3 landscape: a sheet of TWELVE tiny isometric dioramas in a 4 x 3 grid. Each scene sits on its own small slab of ground, on its own dark navy (#1E2A44) rounded square; the twelve squares are the same size, evenly spaced, and do not touch, on a flat charcoal (#1C1F26) background. Light from the upper right, soft shadows falling to the lower left, warm autumn colours, the year 1985 (no modern things). NO lettering, numbers, logos or symbols anywhere: every sign, board, paper, tag and screen is blank. No people. Each scene must be easy to tell apart from the others at a small size, with one clear main object. Row by row, left to right:
Row 1: (1) an open wooden crate overflowing with mixed garden things: a small bench, a lamp, a potted shrub, a rock and a watering can; (2) a little wild corner of nature: one small tree, two shrubs, wild flowers and a few mossy stones together; (3) a tidy paved corner with a park bench, a lamp post, a litter bin and a short white picket fence; (4) a tiny desert oasis: two palms, a small blue pool, a tall cactus and red sandstone rocks on sand.
Row 2: (5) three different trees side by side on grass: a dark pine, a round green oak and a white-barked birch with yellow leaves; (6) a small timber jetty over blue water with a little rowing boat tied to it, reeds and lily pads; (7) a run of white picket fence with a small gate standing open; (8) a blank wooden signpost and a small blank noticeboard with a little roof, on a lawn edge.
Row 3: (9) a stone garden fountain with water running, on a round paved base with flowers; (10) a painter's board showing four square swatches of ground (green grass, pale sand, brown soil, grey gravel) with a big paint roller and two brushes lying on it; (11) a garden rake and a wheelbarrow full of pulled-up plants and leaves on bare raked soil; (12) a neat row of five different potted plants and shrubs on a wooden nursery bench with a trowel.
